item.title: Additive: 3D printing fundamentals

learningObjectives.item: Slice with appropriate settings and justify them

item.content:
How FDM works; slicing; orientation, supports, overhangs, wall thickness, infill; materials (PLA/PETG); mesh hygiene (manifold, normals, STL/3MF); the print queue.

Ideas

Additive constraints as design constraints; the layer as material grain; anisotropy; tolerances for printed fits; the mesh as a representation.

In class

  • Lecture (35)
  • slicer demo (30)
  • print-iteration exercise starts (90)
